fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Disk Encryption Key Name
fields.help: Customer Managed Encryption Key (CMEK) used for disk and volume encryption.

fields.label: IP Range
fields.help: IP range represents the customer-provided CIDR block of length 22 that will be used for the Apigee instance creation.

fields.label: Org ID
fields.help: The Apigee Organization associated with the Apigee instance, in the format 'organizations/{{org_name}}'.

fields.label: Peering Cidr Range
fields.help: The size of the CIDR block range that will be reserved by the instance.

fields.label: Access Logging Config
Enabled
fields.help: Boolean flag that specifies whether the customer access log feature is enabled.

fields.label: Filter
fields.help: Ship the access log entries that match the statusCode defined in the filter.
Access logging configuration enables the access logging feature at the instance.
